sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Cash App (Block)
  • 한 줄 정체성: $cashtag으로 즉시 송금하는 청년 친화 모바일 결제/금융 앱
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Money for everyone — bold simplicity, designed for thumb"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: $ 심볼 + Mint Green(#00D54B) 액션 + 크게 드러낸 잔액과 $cashtag
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 단순, 청년 친화, 대담한
  • 무드 설명: 흰색 또는 검정 바탕에 Cash App Mint를 단호한 액션 컬러로 사용한다. 큰 잔액 숫자와 짧은 문장, $cashtag이 금융 경험을 친근하고 즉각적으로 만든다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 살짝 브루털리즘 (큰 letterform)
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (8~9999px pill)
  • 평면성: Flat

sections.⑨:
Button

.btn {
  font: 800 16px/1 'Cash Sans',Inter,'Pretendard',sans-serif;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0 24px;
  height: 56px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 0;
  transition: background 100ms ease;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-400); }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--color-neutral-900); color: #fff; }      /* 다크 모드에서 변형 */
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-neutral-800); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input { background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 0; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; font-family: inherit; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary-500); }

Card

.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 16px; }
.card-elevated { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.card-outlined { box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }

Badge / cashtag pill

.cashtag { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #000; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.tag { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.tag-solid   { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #000; }
.tag-subtle  { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-primary); }

Navigation

.topnav { padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--bg-base); }
.topnav .logo { width: 28px; height: 28px; background: var(--color-primary-500); border-radius: 8px; color: #000; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 900; }
sections.⑪: 1. 송금 액션 색을 brand mint 외 다른 색 사용 금지 — Mint = pay/receive 2. $cashtag 표기에서 $ 기호 제거 금지 3. mint 위에 흰 텍스트 사용 금지 — 검정 사용 4. 본문에 채도 높은 그라데이션 배경 사용 금지 5. 큰 숫자(잔액)을 표 안에 가두지 말 것 — 큰 fontsize로 단독 표시

<style>
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Cash Sans', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Pretendard', -apple-system, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg-base);
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  .cash-demo {
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 78% 24%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-500) 16%, transparent) 0 12%, transparent 32%),
      var(--bg-base);
  }
  .cash-wrap { width: min(1080px, calc(100% - 40px)); margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 0 44px; }
  .cash-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; }
  .cash-logo {
    width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: var(--color-primary-500); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,213,75,.24);
  }
  .cash-wordmark { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
  .cash-profile {
    margin-left: auto; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  }
  .cash-hero {
    min-height: 500px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(330px,.92fr);
    align-items: center; gap: clamp(28px,6vw,84px); padding: 48px 0 38px;
  }
  .cash-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px;
    color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .cash-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-primary-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-primary-50); }
  .cash-title { max-width: 620px; margin: 0; font-size: clamp(52px,7vw,90px); line-height: .91; letter-spacing: -.065em; font-weight: 900; }
  .cash-title .mint { color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .cash-subtitle { max-width: 510px; margin: 25px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 550; }
  .cash-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 28px; }
  .cash-actions .btn { cursor: pointer; }
  .cash-panel {
    position: relative; isolation: isolate; width: min(100%, 420px); justify-self: end; padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 32px; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  }
  .cash-panel::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -14px 34px auto; height: 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: var(--color-primary-500); z-index: -1; opacity: .9;
  }
  .cash-panel-top { display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .cash-panel-label { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .cash-panel-menu { margin-left: auto; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .cash-total { margin-top: 9px; font-size: clamp(48px,6vw,68px); line-height: 1; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.055em; }
  .cash-total small { font-size: .48em; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .cash-tag { margin-top: 11px; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); }
  .cash-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 8px; margin-top: 24px; }
  .cash-quick-item {
    min-height: 76px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--bg-subtle);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800;
  }
  .cash-quick-item:first-child { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); border-color: transparent; }
  .cash-quick-icon { width: 25px; height: 25px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; }
  .cash-activity { margin-top: 19px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
  .cash-activity-title { margin: 0 0 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .cash-activity-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr auto; gap: 11px; align-items: center; }
  .cash-avatar { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--color-primary-500); font-weight: 900; }
  .cash-person strong, .cash-amount { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 850; }
  .cash-person small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
  .cash-amount { color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .cash-feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 14px; }
  .cash-feature-card { min-height: 245px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 22px; overflow: hidden; }
  .cash-feature-icon { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
  .cash-feature-card h3 { margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
  .cash-feature-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .cash-feature-foot { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 20px; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
  .cash-feature-green { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #000; border-color: transparent; }
  .cash-feature-green p, .cash-feature-green .cash-feature-foot { color: rgba(0,0,0,.72); }
  .cash-feature-green .cash-feature-icon { background: rgba(255,255,255,.26); color: #000; }
  .cash-save-track { height: 8px; margin-top: 19px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: rgba(0,0,0,.16); }
  .cash-save-track span { display: block; width: 68%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #000; }
  .cash-chart { width: 100%; height: 52px; margin-top: auto; overflow: visible; }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .cash-wrap { width: min(100% - 28px,560px); }
    .cash-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-top: 42px; }
    .cash-panel { justify-self: stretch; width: auto; }
    .cash-feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .cash-feature-card { min-height: 210px; }
  }
</style>
